name: Last Supper
overview: The Last Supper, as depicted in the Gospels of Matthew, Mark, and Luke, centers on Jesus and His disciples preparing and partaking in the Passover meal on the first day of unleavened bread. During this meal, Jesus took bread, blessed it, broke it, and gave it to His disciples, declaring it to be His body, symbolizing the sacrifice He was about to make. This event highlights both the fulfillment of the Passover and the institution of a new covenant through Jesus' body, underscoring His impending sacrifice for humanity.
